请先添加并选择函数: Add and select a function first
查找指定范围内的零点或交点。动态作品按保存的开场值计算。: Find zeros or intersections within a range. Dynamic works use the saved opening values.
此范围内未找到孤立的候选点: No isolated candidate points found in this range
函数或范围已变化，请重新查找。: Function or range changed. Search again.
数值查找可能遗漏密集或极窄的交点，可缩小范围再查。加入的点固定于本次结果。: Numerical search may miss dense or very narrow intersections. Try a smaller range. Added points remain fixed at these results.
请为构造选择两个不同且有效的对象: Select two distinct, valid objects for this construction
选择已有点、直线或圆，构造随原对象变化的图形。: Select existing points, lines, or circles to create figures that follow their source objects.
线段按所在直线计算；交点支持直线与圆。: Segments use their infinite lines. Intersections support lines and circles.
试演 · 拖动不会修改作品: Try it · Dragging does not change the work
移除参数 {{name}}，公式中的该参数将固定为初值 {{initial}}。: Remove parameter {{name}}? Its value in formulas will be fixed at its initial value {{initial}}.
应用后同步公式和步骤取值，超出范围的取值移至最近刻度。: Applying updates formulas and step values. Out-of-range values move to the nearest tick.
播放和轨迹只用于试演，重置或换步骤后清空轨迹。下载的演示保留相同设置。: Playback and traces are for trying the work. Resetting or changing steps clears traces. Downloaded presentations keep these settings.
选择新的公式结构会替换当前公式，是否继续？: Choosing a new formula structure will replace the current formula. Continue?
源码已保存，公式暂时无法显示。请修正后再次保存；当前版本仅可下载制作源。: Source saved, but the formula cannot be displayed. Correct it and save again. Only the source can be downloaded for this version.
当前公式可在 LaTeX 源码中继续编辑，也可以选择新的结构。: Continue editing this formula in LaTeX source, or choose a new structure.
选择一种结构，填写内容后即可看到公式。: Choose a structure and fill in its contents to see the formula.
公式组件加载失败，请重试: Could not load the formula component. Please retry
输入公式，预览会显示在这里: Enter a formula to preview it here
无法精确定位，请检查 LaTeX 源码。: Could not locate the error precisely. Check the LaTeX source.
从上到下判断条件，使用第一个满足条件的表达式。: Conditions are checked from top to bottom. The first matching expression is used.
可写 2x、x²、sin(x)。ln 为自然对数，log\n: Use 2x, x², or sin(x). ln is the natural logarithm and log is the common logarithm. Use parentheses to make division unambiguous.
从画布上方添加图形，或选择一个示例开始。: Add a figure above the canvas, or start from an example.
文件超过 1 MiB，无法编辑或运行；可以取回原件。: The file exceeds 1 MiB and cannot be edited or run. You can retrieve the original.
编码不支持或文件超过 1 MiB，无法编辑或运行；可以取回原件。: Unsupported encoding or file exceeds 1 MiB. It cannot be edited or run, but you can retrieve the original.
原件已上传，保存作品后可修改源码。: Original uploaded. Save the work before editing its source.
源码超过 1 MiB，可保存及取回，无法运行预览。: Source exceeds 1 MiB. It can be saved and retrieved but cannot run in preview.
作品状态已变化，请重新读取并确认: The work’s status changed. Reload and confirm
请另存作品后替换本处: Save a new copy of the work before replacing this reference
沿面的边界依次选择顶点，所有顶点须共面。: Select vertices in order along the face boundary. All vertices must be coplanar.
截平面：ax + by + cz = d。随顶点和系数变化重新计算。: Cutting plane: ax + by + cz = d. Recalculated when vertices or coefficients change.
适用于已定义完整面的封闭凸多面体，正方体与棱锥示例可直接使用。: For closed convex polyhedra with all faces defined. The cube and pyramid examples are ready to use.
点击公式中的位置直接输入，用方向键移动。选中内容后，可将它放入分式或根式。: Click within the formula to type and use arrow keys to move. Select content to wrap it in a fraction or radical.
公式编辑器暂时无法加载，源码仍保留。: The formula editor could not load. Your source is kept.
历史版本暂时无法读取。当前作品没有改变。: History cannot be read right now. The current work is unchanged.
选一版查看。恢复后先作为当前草稿，保存时生成新版本，已有备课引用保持原样。: Select a version to inspect. Restoring makes it the current draft; saving creates a new version. Existing lesson references stay unchanged.
HTML 历史版本不会自动运行。恢复为草稿后，可查看源码并运行预览。: Historical HTML versions do not run automatically. Restore as a draft to view the source and run a preview.
排出清晰公式，放进讲义或课件: Create clear formulas for handouts or slides
画函数图像、几何图形与标注: Draw functions, geometric figures, and labels
拖动参数，观察图形如何变化: Drag parameters to explore how figures change
这节课，需要什么数学素材？: What math materials do you need for this lesson?
草稿保留在本设备，可继续制作: Draft kept on this device. Continue creating any time
制作并保存后，你的作品会留在这里。: Your works will appear here after you create and save them.
原请求格式暂不支持，已保留设备资料，请核对后处理: The original request format is unsupported. Device data is kept. Check it before proceeding
响应无法确认，请重试原请求: Response not confirmed. Retry the original request
参数名须以英文字母开头，不能使用 x、pi 或函数名。: Parameter names must start with an English letter and cannot be x, pi, or a function name.
最大值须大于最小值，且范围须能被正数步长整分。: Maximum must exceed minimum, and the range must divide evenly by a positive step.
初值须在范围内，并落在步长刻度上。: Initial value must be in range and aligned to a step.
参数标签须为1至100字。: Parameter labels must contain 1 to 100 characters.
参数范围与初值须在正负一百万以内，步长须在百万分之一至一百万之间。: Range and initial values must be within ±1,000,000; step must be between 0.000001 and 1,000,000.
本地字体加载失败，预览暂不可用。: Local font could not load. Preview unavailable.
无法恢复待确认的文件上传，请检查设备存储: Could not restore the pending upload. Check device storage
导入会替换当前未保存稿，是否继续？: Importing replaces the current unsaved draft. Continue?
制作源超过 1 MiB，请选择工坊下载的 JSON 文件。: Source exceeds 1 MiB. Select a JSON file downloaded from the workshop.
文件不是有效的制作源 JSON，当前草稿已保留。: This is not valid source JSON. The current draft is kept.
请选择工坊下载的公式或图形制作源 JSON；HTML 演示请使用 HTML 导入: Select formula or figure source JSON downloaded from the workshop. Use HTML import for HTML presentations.
导入作品会替换当前未保存稿，是否继续？: Importing this work replaces the current unsaved draft. Continue?
设备存储空间不足，请先整理设备草稿，再重试导入。: Device storage is full. Organize device drafts, then retry importing.
制作源已导入为新作品，可以继续修改。: Source imported as a new work. You can continue editing.
设备草稿无法保留，请先保存到服务端: Could not retain device draft. Save to the server first
设备草稿空间不足，请保存到服务端: Device draft storage is full. Save to the server
服务器内容已变化，本地稿保留，请对照当前版本: Server content changed. Local draft kept. Compare with the current version
暂时无法保存或读取，请稍后确认: Could not save or read right now. Confirm later
请先确认当前操作结果: Confirm the current action result first
请先确认上次保存结果: Confirm the previous save result first
新建作品会替换当前未保存稿，是否继续？: Creating a new work replaces the current unsaved draft. Continue?
打开作品会替换当前未保存稿，是否继续？: Opening this work replaces the current unsaved draft. Continue?
请先保存当前源码，再另存作品: Save the current source before saving as a new work
彻底删除“{{title}}”？作品及历史版本将无法恢复。已有备课中采用的内容和: Permanently delete “{{title}}”? The work and its version history cannot be recovered. Content adopted in lesson plans and downloaded files are kept.
作品已归档，可在“已归档”中恢复: Work archived. Restore it from Archived
对象标识已存在，请使用不同标识: Object ID already exists. Use a different ID
构造引用须有效且不能形成循环: Construction references must be valid and cannot form a cycle
丢弃本设备的未保存修改？已保存的作品仍会保留。: Discard unsaved changes on this device? Saved works will be kept.
使用示例会替换当前图形及设置，是否继续？: Using this example replaces the current figure and settings. Continue?
移除此面也会移除依赖完整多面体的截面，是否继续？: Removing this face also removes cross-sections that depend on the complete polyhedron. Continue?
移除此对象也会移除 {{count}} 个依赖它的构造、面或截面，是否继续？: Removing this object also removes {{count}} dependent constructions, faces, or cross-sections. Continue?
恢复历史版本会替换当前未保存修改，是否继续？: Restoring this version replaces current unsaved changes. Continue?
已恢复版本 {{version}} 为草稿，保存后生成新版本。: Version {{version}} restored as a draft. Saving creates a new version.
请先保存平面图形，再制作动态副本。: Save the plane figure before creating a dynamic copy.
已保留原图。设置参数，并在图形表达式中使用参数名；保存后建立独立的动态作品。: The original figure is kept. Set parameters and use their names in expressions. Saving creates an independent dynamic work.
原账户草稿已保留: The original account’s draft is kept
重选原文件并确认上传: Select original file again and confirm upload
以服务器版本为基线保留本地稿: Keep local draft using server version as baseline
保存作品后即可下载: Save the work to download it
使用棱锥会替换当前图形，是否继续？: Using a pyramid replaces the current figure. Continue?
HTML 演示已归档，可下载查看或恢复后运行。: HTML presentation archived. Download it to view, or restore it to run.
作品格式需要更新，请升级后编辑。: The work format needs updating. Upgrade to edit.
选择示例后，可以改顶点、添加棱和调整观察角度。: Choose an example, then edit vertices, add edges, and adjust the viewing angle.
先试着拖动参数，再调整图形和讲解步骤。: Try dragging parameters, then adjust figures and teaching steps.
输入函数表达式，或添加点、线段和标注。: Enter a function expression, or add points, segments, and labels.
本地字体加载失败，请重试: Could not load local font. Please retry
